Kryteria odbioru to sprawdzalne warunki: Acceptance criteria are verifiable conditions for considering the work complete. They may concern compliance with the agreed scope, whether features work, whether tests have been carried out, whether access has been handed over and whether reported errors have been fixed. Their selection should match the specific project.
Dokładniejszy harmonogram jest łatwiejsz: A more detailed schedule is easier to compare than a short declaration of a deadline without stages and conditions. It also makes it possible to separate the revisions planned in the project from later changes ordered additionally.
Hasła takie jak „SEO w cenie”, „szybka s: Slogans such as “SEO included”, “a fast website” or “fully responsive” have to be translated into specific work and a way of verifying it. Dobra oferta i umowa powinny jasno okreś: A good proposal and contract should clearly define the build scope, revisions, acceptance, rights, hosting and support after publication — that way technical promises can be turned into specific criteria to check.
Prawa do elementów strony i techniczny d: The rights to the website's elements and technical access to its resources need to be assessed separately. Zakres uprawnień zależy od rodzaju eleme: The scope of permissions depends on the type of element and the content of the specific contract. The source materials are for information only, so legal advice may be needed when assessing individual provisions.

Samo opłacenie projektu nie powinno zast: Simply paying for the project shouldn't replace checking the provisions of the contract. What matters is the distinction between a transfer of rights and a license, and defining the scope of the permissions granted.

Jasne prawa oraz dostępy ograniczają nie: Clear rights and access limit uncertainty when developing the website later or changing contractors. However, they don't determine full portability of the project, because that also depends on the technology used and the content of the contract.
Ostateczny wybór powinien uwzględniać zg: The final choice should take into account compliance with the required scope, the total cost, the timeline, the acceptance terms, the rights and support.
